dcterms:description: FB15K-237 is a filtered version of the FB15K dataset from Freebase, containing triples that represent relationships between entities, with inverse triples removed to create a more challenging link prediction task.
dcterms:title: FB15K-237

dcterms:description: WN18RR is a filtered version of the WN18 dataset from WordNet, designed for link prediction tasks, with inverse triples removed to enhance the difficulty of the prediction challenge.
dcterms:title: WN18RR
